name: Sakata (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Sakata city emblem in blue and green: a disc of blue and green with white wave-like lines.
history: Municipal flag of Sakata, a city in Yamagata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 22 March 2005.

features.role: Sakata city emblem — a disc of blue and green with white wave-like lines
